fullContentHtml:
Rajasthan RPSC Deputy Jailor Final Marks / Merit List 2026 – Full Details

Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the marks/merit list/ final answer key for the post of Deputy Jailor. This recruitment was released for 73 posts. Applications for the RPSC Deputy Jailor Recruitment 2024 were accepted from 08 July 2024, to 06 August 2024. The written examination was held on 13 July 2025. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their RPSC Deputy Jailor Marks/Merit List / Final Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 08 July 2024
  • Last Date : 06 August 2024
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 August 2024
  • Exam Date : 13 July 2025
  • Exam City Details : 07 July 2025
  • Admit Card : 10 July 2025
  • Answer Key : 05 August 2025
  • Result : 19 November 2025
  • Final Answer Key : 05 October 2026
  • Final Marks : 05 October 2026
  • Merit List : 05 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • OBC, BC : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 400/–
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 500/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
